title: Computes Local False Discovery Rates
text: locfdr computes local false discovery rates following methodology Efron (2004, 2007). Given vector z-scores simultaneous hypothesis tests, estimates mixture density f(z), null sub-density p₀f₀(z), local false discovery rate fdr(z) = p₀f₀(z) / f(z).
